title: Atlantic City
description: A boardwalk numbers runner feels young again with a casino clam shucker and a lucky cocaine deal.

title: Ulzana's Raid
description: A trail-worn scout and an idealistic cavalryman have opposing views on how to handle a group of rampaging Apaches.

title: Local Hero
description: An oilman (Peter Riegert) goes native in a quirky Scottish town his Texas boss (Burt Lancaster) expects him to buy.

title: Lord Jeff
description: A wayward British orphan (Freddie Bartholomew) graduates from the merchant marine academy to the Queen Mary.

title: Sweethearts
description: Married co-stars (Jeanette MacDonald, Nelson Eddy) of a Broadway operetta have a big fight, split up and then get back together.

title: A Christmas Carol
description: Dickens' London miser Ebenezer Scrooge (Reginald Owen) meets the ghosts of Christmases past, present and yet to come.

title: Goodbye, Mr. Chips
description: Charles Edward Chipping imposes strict discipline on his young charges, but the love of spirited young suffragette Katherine Ellis brings the Latin instructor out of his shell and makes him a beloved campus institution.

title: Andy Hardy Gets Spring Fever
description: Judge Hardy (Lewis Stone) tries to talk Andy (Mickey Rooney) out of quitting high school to marry his drama teacher.

title: A Yank at Eton
description: A rowdy American boy's (Mickey Rooney) British stepfather (Ian Hunter) puts him in a stuffy prep school.

title: National Velvet
description: An English girl's dream of racing her horse in the Grand National thunders to reality with the help of a former jockey.

title: Fortunes of Captain Blood
description: The Spanish send a cruel nobleman (George Macready) to sink an exiled Irish doctor (Louis Hayward) turned pirate.

title: The Wizard of Oz
description: After a tornado whisks Kansas farm girl Dorothy (Judy Garland) to a magic land, she must travel to the Emerald City for help in getting back home.

title: Planet of the Apes
description: An astronaut and his team crash on a world ruled by intelligent, talking simians who treat humans like animals.

title: Monkey Business
description: Drinking an elixir makes a professor (Cary Grant) and his wife (Ginger Rogers) act teenage and worse.

title: Bedtime for Bonzo
description: A professor (Ronald Reagan) hires a nanny (Diana Lynn) to help him raise a chimp, hoping to decide nature vs. nurture.

title: Every Which Way But Loose
description: A truck driver (Clint Eastwood) woos a country singer (Sondra Locke) and fights bare-knuckle brawls egged on by his orangutan.

title: MGM Parade Show
description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

title: Royal Wedding
description: A brother (Fred Astaire) and sister (Jane Powell) take their act to 1947 London. Includes Astaire's famous dance on the ceiling.

title: Singin' in the Rain
description: A silent-film star (Gene Kelly) loves a chorus girl (Debbie Reynolds) who dubs his squeaky-voiced co-star in a 1927 Hollywood talkie.

title: Brigadoon
description: New Yorkers (Gene Kelly, Van Johnson) hunting in the Scottish Highlands find a magic village that fell asleep in 1754.

title: Annie Get Your Gun
description: Sharpshooter Annie Oakley (Betty Hutton) joins Buffalo Bill's (Louis Calhern) Wild West Show and aims to win her man (Howard Keel).

title: Seven Brides for Seven Brothers
description: When an Oregon trapper decides to marry, his six rowdy brothers aim to follow suit, though not one has a sweetheart yet.

title: Meet Me in St. Louis
description: A St. Louis lawyer's (Leon Ames) family (Judy Garland, Margaret O'Brien) stays in town for the 1904 World's Fair.

title: The Wizard of Oz
description: After a tornado whisks Kansas farm girl Dorothy (Judy Garland) to a magic land, she must travel to the Emerald City for help in getting back home.

title: The Four Seasons
description: Things change for a middle-class couple (Alan Alda, Carol Burnett) and two other couples they vacation with four times a year.

title: Annie
description: Daddy Warbucks (Albert Finney) protects little orphan Annie (Aileen Quinn) from Miss Hannigan (Carol Burnett) and crooks in Depression-era New York.

title: Who's Been Sleeping in My Bed?
description: A psychoanalyst's secretary (Carol Burnett) arranges a fake marriage for her friend (Elizabeth Montgomery) to make a TV star (Dean Martin) jealous.

title: My Fair Lady
description: Oscar-winning adaptation of the Broadway hit about an English professor (Rex Harrison) who teaches a cockney merchant (Audrey Hepburn) to be a lady.

title: Lili
description: A French teen (Leslie Caron) joins a carnival and meets a lying magician (Jean-Pierre Aumont) and a loving puppeteer (Mel Ferrer).

title: Andy Hardy Meets Debutante
description: Andy (Mickey Rooney) goes to New York with the judge (Lewis Stone) and tries, through another girl (Judy Garland), to meet a debutante.

title: Andy Hardy's Private Secretary
description: Andy's (Mickey Rooney) so busy with his secretary (Kathryn Grayson) planning the high-school graduation that he flunks a final.

title: Hail the Conquering Hero
description: Preston Sturges' satire about a sickly soldier discharged from duty and mistaken for a war hero when he returns home.

title: The Great McGinty
description: A dimwitted drifter finds his values changing after he is manipulated into becoming a successful public official.

title: Christmas in July
description: A penniless office worker goes on a spending spree after fellow workers trick him into believing he has won a contest.

title: The Palm Beach Story
description: An inventor's (Joel McCrea) wife (Claudette Colbert) meets some sporting millionaires on a train to Florida.

title: The Lady Eve
description: Father-daughter cardsharps (Barbara Stanwyck, Charles Coburn) fleece a rich man's son (Henry Fonda) on a cruise ship.

title: Sullivan's Travels
description: A Hollywood director's desire to produce a film about real people and human suffering leads him on an odyssey as a hobo.

title: The First Five Minutes: The Title Design Legacy of Dan Perri
description: Designer Dan Perri details his life, creative career and title sequence work for some of the most influential and widely recognized films in cinematic history.

title: Airplane!
description: A pilot (Robert Hays) afraid to fly follows his stewardess ex-girlfriend (Julie Hagerty) and must take over for the poisoned crew.

title: Taxi Driver
description: A disturbed New York cabby (Robert De Niro) befriends a teenage hooker (Jodie Foster) and frees her from her pimp.

title: Raging Bull
description: The violent nature of prizefighter Jake LaMotta leads first to a boxing championship, then to a downward spiral of self-destruction.

title: California Split
description: Two compulsive gamblers (George Segal, Elliott Gould) set out on a gambling streak, searching for a big payday. While they have some lucky moments, they also contend with setbacks that threaten to derail their hedonistic betting binge.

title: The Heavenly Body
description: An astronomer's (William Powell) neglected wife (Hedy Lamarr) thinks an air-raid warden (James Craig) is the mystery man her astrologer predicted.

title: Athena
description: A singer and a lawyer (Edmund Purdom) fall for Athena (Jane Powell) and Minerva (Debbie Reynolds), two sisters out of seven named after constellations.

title: Human Beasts
description: A hit man double crosses his yakuza employers and flees with a cache of diamonds, taking refuge with a family who have plans of their own.

title: Adventures of Rusty
description: A boy (Ted Donaldson) gets used to his new stepmother (Margaret Lindsay) and pet, once a vicious police dog.

title: Tom & Jerry
description:
Ventriloquist Cat
A sneaky alley cat uses a ventriloquist device to trick an angry bulldog into believing he is in many different places.

title: The Flea Circus
description: A dog threatens the fortunes of a flea circus.

title: The Muppets Take Manhattan
description: Kermit and company try to take their variety show to Broadway, while Miss Piggy grows jealous of a friendly waitress.
